title: Outlay Worm module
tagline: Outlay is a Point of Sale application and tipping links, that uses Wormhole to make cross chain payments, in order to boost Crypto and web3 adoption.
description: Outlay is a Point of Sale application and tipping links, powered by AI. Right now for this hackathon we focused fully on EVM compatibility and primarily created a module for Wormhole to make Solana to EVM transactions and viceversa. Our aim is to masively boost the adoption of Crypto, Web3 and USDC for payments.
how_its_made:
- All EVMs transactions are controlled through Ethers.js and WalletConnectV2 on mainnet.
- Crosschain payments through Wormhole.
- Generative AI analysis done via AWS (Amazon Web Services) and the Text model Llama2 (Meta).

Particularly, all crosschain transfers with Wormhole work natively in our POS and maintaining the payment experience through QR with WalletConnect v2, payments can be made with any wallet compatible with this protocol.

The networks that our POS supports to accept USDC are Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, Ethereum, Solana and Polygon.
